## The Problem I Found

> While building gradient-based training diagnostics for LLMs, I discovered that fine-tuned models systematically learn shortcuts instead of reasoning — and **no tool exists to detect or fix this at training time.**

Every company fine-tuning LLMs faces the same failure mode: models that ace benchmarks, then fail silently on real customer inputs. The gap between benchmark performance and production reliability is 20–40 percentage points — and it's invisible until deployment.
